systems.system: Interoperability protocol and draft convention between the INSD and the DGMEC for access to civil-status data
systems.owner: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD) and Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil (DGMEC)
systems.tiers: national; the convention was still a draft in October 2025

note: The statistics institute's plan: civil-status statistics reports on births (2023), divorces (2024) and marriages (2025), and a data-access link with the DGMEC not yet in effect; nothing on how offices record events.
